stories.title: French Lawmakers Back Crypto Tax That Hits Stablecoin Swaps
stories.summary: French members of parliament have backed a tax measure on crypto activity. The measure appears to hit stablecoin swaps the hardest. The source gives no detail on the tax rate or its exact scope.
stories.whyItMatters: A French move to tax stablecoin swaps could set a pattern other EU states follow, raising costs for traders and liquidity providers.
whatToWatch: Final passage of the measure in the French parliament
Response from stablecoin issuers and exchanges serving French users
questions: What tax rate applies, and to which stablecoin pairs?
When would the measure take effect?

sources.title: French MPs back crypto tax, and stablecoin swaps take the hit

stories.title: Hyperliquid Trader Loses $469,000, Then Opens $16M ETH Short
stories.summary: A trader on the Hyperliquid platform lost $469,000 within hours. The same trader then opened a new position betting against Ether worth about $16 million, per the source. No detail is given on the trader's identity or reasoning.
stories.whyItMatters: Large, fast leveraged bets on perpetuals platforms show how volatile crypto derivatives trading remains, which can spill into spot prices.
whatToWatch: Whether the new ETH short position gains or loses value
questions: Who is the trader, and what is the thesis behind the short?
Is this an isolated bet or part of a wider shift in positioning?

sources.title: Whale loses $469,000 in hours on Hyperliquid, yet re-enters with $16M ETH short bet

stories.title: Crypto Hacks Jump 55% to $1.2 Billion, but Private-Key Theft Falls 30%
stories.summary: Crypto-related hacks rose 55% to $1.2 billion in losses, according to the source. At the same time, theft tied to stolen private keys fell 30%, which suggests attackers are shifting methods. The report does not state the period covered or a breakdown by incident.
stories.whyItMatters: Rising hack losses remain a core risk to trust in exchanges and protocols, even as some attack methods become harder to pull off.
whatToWatch: Which attack methods are replacing private-key theft
Whether exchanges and protocols announce new security measures
questions: What time period does the $1.2 billion figure cover?
Which incidents or protocols account for the largest losses?

sources.title: Crypto hacks surge 55% to $1.2B, but key theft drops by 30%

stories.title: Tether Loses Nearly $5 Billion in Exchange Balances to USDC and RLUSD
stories.summary: Tether's USDT has lost close to $5 billion in balances held on crypto exchanges. Rivals USDC and RLUSD appear to be gaining ground by paying incentives for liquidity, per the source. The report does not say which exchanges or over what period this happened.
stories.whyItMatters: Shifts in stablecoin market share affect trading liquidity and show how incentive spending is reshaping competition among dollar tokens.
whatToWatch: Whether Tether responds with its own liquidity incentives
Continued growth or stalling in USDC and RLUSD exchange balances
questions: Over what time period did this shift occur?
How much are USDC and RLUSD issuers spending to win this liquidity?

sources.title: Tether loses nearly $5 billion across crypto exchanges as USDC and RLUSD rivals pay to win liquidity

stories.title: Hoskinson Unveils New Cardano Code as Network's Thin TVL Shows
stories.summary: Charles Hoskinson presented new code for the Cardano network. The announcement also drew attention to Cardano's total value locked, which sits at $63 million, a figure the source frames as exposing a gap versus rival chains. The source gives no further detail on what the code does.
stories.whyItMatters: Cardano's small total value locked next to rival chains raises questions about real DeFi adoption, despite continued development work.
whatToWatch: What the new code does and when it ships
questions: What problem does the new code solve?
What benchmark is the $63 million TVL being compared against?

sources.title: Hoskinson reveals new code for Cardano, but $63M TVL exposes a gap

stories.title: Binance Launches Free AI Trading Tool, but Users Bear Full Liability
stories.summary: Binance has rolled out a free AI-powered trading feature. The exchange states that users remain fully liable for any losses the tool causes, according to the source. The report gives little detail on how the AI makes its trading decisions.
stories.whyItMatters: AI trading tools lower the barrier to algorithmic strategies for retail users, but full user liability puts all the downside risk on traders.
whatToWatch: User adoption and any reported losses tied to the tool
Whether Binance changes the liability terms
questions: How does the AI tool make its trading decisions?
What track record backs its performance claims?

sources.title: Binance opens free AI trading, yet user liability remains 100%

stories.title: Strategy's Discretionary Cash Falls 72% as Buyback Authorization Rises to $3 Billion
stories.summary: Strategy, the Bitcoin-holding company, saw its discretionary cash fall 72%. Its board raised the stock buyback authorization to $3 billion, per the source. The figures suggest the company is directing more resources toward share repurchases. The source does not explain the cause of the cash decline.
stories.whyItMatters: Strategy's balance sheet is closely tied to its large Bitcoin holdings, so its capital decisions signal how it is managing both confidence and risk.
whatToWatch: Whether Strategy executes buybacks under the new authorization
Future disclosures on cash reserves and Bitcoin purchases
questions: Why did discretionary cash fall so sharply?
Will the buyback divert funds away from future Bitcoin purchases?

sources.title: Strategy’s discretionary cash falls 72% as buyback authorization rises to $3 billion

stories.title: Wall Street's Bitcoin Bears Quietly Pulled Back Despite Plunge Toward $80,000
stories.summary: Bitcoin fell toward $80,000, yet institutional short positioning against it reportedly eased rather than grew, according to the source. The shift is described as quiet, not a public call. No specific data on position sizes or which institutions moved is given.
stories.whyItMatters: Institutional positioning offers a read on how professional investors view Bitcoin's downside risk, apart from retail sentiment and headline price moves.
whatToWatch: Bitcoin's price action around the $80,000 level
questions: Which institutions or funds reduced their bearish bets?
What is driving the retreat if the price kept falling?

sources.title: Wall Street’s Bitcoin bears quietly retreated despite recent plunge toward $80,000

stories.title: Kraken's Opt-In European Wallet Can Expose Spot Holdings to Futures Losses
stories.summary: Kraken has introduced an opt-in wallet feature in Europe that can expose a user's spot holdings to losses from futures trading, according to the source. Because it is opt-in, only users who choose the feature are affected. The source does not detail how the cross-margining works.
stories.whyItMatters: Features that link spot and derivatives accounts can turn a futures loss into a spot-holdings loss, a risk users may not fully grasp before opting in.
whatToWatch: How Kraken discloses the risk to users before opt-in
questions: What specific disclosures does Kraken give users before they opt in?
How many users have enabled the feature so far?

sources.title: Kraken’s opt-in European wallet can expose spot holdings to futures losses

stories.title: Aave's Proposed USAT Gateway Could Block Return Swaps After Deposit
stories.summary: A proposal for Aave would add a USAT gateway that, as structured, could stop users from swapping back out once they deposit, per the source. The report frames this as a possible design flaw rather than an intended lock-up. No detail on the proposal's status or vote timeline is given.
stories.whyItMatters: A one-way gateway could trap user funds, a material risk for any DeFi protocol where depositors expect to reverse their position.
whatToWatch: Whether the proposal is amended before a vote
questions: Is this a deliberate design choice or an unintended flaw in the proposal?
Has Aave governance addressed the concern yet?

sources.title: Aave’s proposed USAT gateway could cut off the return swap after a deposit
